subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose managed per-agent plugin installs in core before the scoped discovery, update, uninstall, doctor, and plugin-code trust semantics are fully defined?
rationale: This changes where plugin code is installed and how persisted plugin lifecycle records are keyed, so automation cannot choose the permanent security and upgrade contract safely.

options.title: Complete The Scoped Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Require the PR or a replacement to cover install, uninstall, update, index, discovery, doctor, docs, and agent validation before merge.

options.title: Pause For Product/Security Design
options.body: Keep the branch open while maintainers decide whether per-agent managed plugin installs belong in core and what isolation guarantees they need.

options.title: Accept Install-Only Experiment
options.body: Merge the install-only surface knowingly, leaving scoped uninstall/update/security semantics for follow-up and accepting operator-facing risk.

recommendation.title: Complete The Scoped Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Require the PR or a replacement to cover install, uninstall, update, index, discovery, doctor, docs, and agent validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin install persistence and CLI lifecycle history points most strongly to steipete for deciding the durable core contract.
